D: Mathematical Calculation

  1. Set [A] = [A₃] at t₁:

    • 3x = [A₃]₀ - x

  2. Solve for x:

    • 4x = [A₃]₀

    • x = [A₃]₀ / 4

  3. Find [A₃] at t₁:

    • [A₃] = [A₃]₀ - x = [A₃]₀ - [A₃]₀ / 4

    • [A₃] = (3/4) [A₃]₀

  4. Determine the fraction of A₃ remaining:

    • [A₃] / [A₃]₀ = 3/4

  5. Determine the fraction of A₃ reacted:

    • 1 - (3/4) = 1/4

  6. Interpret the result:

    • At t₁, 1/4 of A₃ has reacted, and 3/4 of A₃ remains. This means t₁ represents the time when 1/4 of the reaction is complete.

E: Final Answer
The time t₁ corresponds to t₁/₄ (time for 1/4 completion). So the correct option is (3).

Asking About : The correct arrangement of microtubules in a cross- section of cilia or flagella.
Concept : Understanding the ultrastructure of cilia and flagella, specifically the "9+2" arrangement of microtubules.
Solution or Explanation :-
Cilia and flagella have a characteristic "9+2" arrangement of microtubules.
This means they have 9 peripheral doublet microtubules surrounding 2 central singlet microtubules.
Radial spokes connect the peripheral doublets to the central sheath.
Answer : 1.  9, 2, 9
